title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — November 06, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B8.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.7 (Peaked November 06, 2026 at 18:45 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: C5.6 (Peaked November 06, 2026 at 02:51 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 402 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

What are you seeing out there? 💛💫

Several bright active regions and a broad dark coronal structure stand out today; the coronagraph shows no clear CME.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
